 GAME PREVIEW: 5 Things You Should Know About Clippers vs. Hornets
 LAClippers November 15, 2026 10:30 AM PST LA CLIPPERS VS. CHARLOTTE HORNETS
FIVE THINGS TO KNOW
 Last Matchup: 01/12/2026 | LAC 117 - CHA 109 | K.Leonard: 35 PTS - L.Ball: 25 PTS
 The Clippers have won 16 straight games against the Hornets, their longest win streak against any opponent all-time. Additionally, it is tied for Charlotte’s third-longest losing streak against any single opponent (21 vs. Mavs, 2000-12; 17 vs. Bulls, 1989-92).
 The Clippers are 14-6 in their last 20 games against Eastern Conference opponents dating back to January 9. Only five teams in the NBA have a better record against the opposite conference over that time.
 The Clippers scored 19 points in the final six minutes in their win over the Thunder on Friday. At least one of Brook Lopez (nine points, one assist) or Darius Garland (eight points, three assists) scored or assisted (or both) on all 19 of those points.
 Brook Lopez scored a team-high 26 points in the Clippers’ win over Oklahoma City on Friday. At 38 years, 226 days old, Lopez became the oldest player to record a 25-point game in franchise history, surpassing Sam Cassell (38 years, 69 days old on January 26, 2008).
 BONUS: Keaton Wagler has 136 points in his first 11 NBA games despite coming off the bench in all of them, the most by any Clippers player who came off the bench in each of his first 11 NBA games. The only players over the last four seasons to come off the bench in their first 11 NBA games and score 136 or more points are Dylan Harper (150) and Cedric Coward (163), both last season.
